intro: Burhanpur stands on the Tapti in southern Madhya Pradesh, just across the border from Maharashtra's Jalgaon district. It is an old Mughal-era town known today for its power looms and the banana farms around it. FunPlay Systems is about 410 km away at Vasai, which makes Burhanpur closer to our factory than most of Madhya Pradesh. We supply schools, colonies, societies and gardens here by road.

Because the route from Vasai runs through Maharashtra, Burhanpur orders reach the site without a long trip across central India. Distance still shapes how you plan, though. A truck needs to reach the site, and the ground needs to be ready the day the equipment arrives. Burhanpur's summers are very hot and the Tapti valley gets a strong monsoon, so we suggest installing in the cooler, drier months where possible.

sections.h: Getting your site ready for delivery day
sections.html:
• Check that a loaded truck can reach the gate. Narrow lanes in the old town may mean carrying parts the last stretch by hand, so tell us in advance.
  • Clear, level and mark the play area to match the layout drawing.
  • Arrange water and a power point nearby for the installation team.

Once the ground is ready, installation goes quickly, whether the posts are grouted or the pieces are self-standing. A Double Arc Swing and a slide are easy to fit in one visit. See our Madhya Pradesh page, or our outdoor gym equipment in Burhanpur.

faq.q: How far is Burhanpur from your factory?
faq.a: About 410 km by road from our factory in Vasai East, near Mumbai. We deliver and install with our own team or a dealer serving the region.

faq.q: What should we arrange before the installation team arrives?
faq.a: Truck access to the site, a cleared and levelled play area matching the layout drawing, and water and a power point nearby. Tell us early if the last stretch is too narrow for a truck.

faq.q: When is a good time to install a playground in Burhanpur?
faq.a: The cooler, drier months after the monsoon. Grouting sets best in dry weather, and the team can work longer hours than in the peak of summer.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: 'Arrange water and a power point' is a practical site-prep suggestion, not a stated FunPlay requirement; confirm with the installation team.

intro: Buxar sits on the Ganga at Bihar's western edge, facing Uttar Pradesh across the river. Pilgrims come for its ghats and temples, and the town's schools, community trusts and residential colonies make up most of the local demand for play areas. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,330 km away, and sends it by road to Buxar.

A community trust or temple committee setting up a children's corner usually has two needs. The equipment must take crowds of children on a festival day, and it must need little looking after the rest of the year. Merry-go-rounds, multi see-saws and wide slides do both. Ganga plain summers are very hot and the monsoon is heavy, so we suggest galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic on a raised, drained base.

sections.h: A children's corner for a trust or community ground
sections.html:
On busy days, crowds of children arrive at once. Pick pieces that spread them out, such as a merry-go-round, a Double See Saw and a slide, rather than one tall structure everyone queues for.

Keep the play corner away from cooking areas, generators and any steps down to the river. A fence with one entrance helps volunteers watch the space. Grout the posts into concrete, as river-plain soil softens in the rains. For adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Buxar.

faq.q: What playground equipment suits a community or trust ground?
faq.a: Pieces that many children use together, such as merry-go-rounds, multi see-saws and wide slides. They handle crowds on festival days and need only routine checks the rest of the year.

faq.q: Do you supply playground equipment to Buxar?
faq.a: Yes. Equipment made at our Vasai factory is sent to Buxar by road and installed by our team or a dealer serving Bihar.

faq.q: How do we keep a playground safe near a river?
faq.a: Fence it, keep one gated entrance, and set it well back from steps or banks. Raise the base and grout the posts so the ground stays firm after floods.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: No hub in the fact sheet for Buxar, so no state page is linked.

intro: Chandrapur in eastern Vidarbha is a coal and power town, and it is also the gateway to the Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve. Its summers are among the hottest in Maharashtra. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to Chandrapur's schools, mining and power-plant colonies, wildlife resorts and municipal gardens. We make it at our factory in Vasai, about 670 km away, and send it by road.

Resorts around Tadoba host families who come for safaris, and children have long hours to fill between the morning and evening drives. A play area on the lawn helps, and a jungle theme ties it to the reason guests came. Our CoreCraft range includes a jungle-themed series, and our Funplay Originals have nature-inspired designs. Both use galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic, which handle Vidarbha's fierce dry heat without cracking or rusting.

sections.h: Jungle-themed play areas for Tadoba resorts
sections.html:
The Forestia series is built around a jungle theme, with stations such as King Kong Play Park. Earthy greens and browns from our colour range sit well in a forest setting.

Shade is essential here, since afternoon temperatures in May are punishing. Place the play area under existing trees, or add a gazebo, and plan for children to use it in the early morning and evening. Rubber flooring is cooler underfoot than stone or concrete. See our Maharashtra page, or our outdoor gym equipment in Chandrapur.

faq.q: Do you have jungle-themed playground equipment?
faq.a: Yes. Our CoreCraft Forestia series is designed around a jungle theme, and our Funplay Originals include nature-inspired structures. Both suit resorts near wildlife reserves.

faq.q: How do resorts keep a play area usable in extreme heat?
faq.a: Put it under tree shade or beside a gazebo, choose lighter or earthy colours, and lay rubber flooring. Most children will use it in the morning and evening.

faq.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Chandrapur?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture at our Vasai factory, about 670 km away, and deliver by road. Our team or a dealer in Maharashtra installs it.

intro: Chapra is the headquarters of Saran district in north Bihar, near where the Ghaghara joins the Ganga. Many of the playground enquiries from towns like Chapra come from small private schools and play schools that are adding an outdoor area for their youngest pupils. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 1,410 km away, and sends it to Chapra by road.

A play school ground is often a small yard behind the building, sometimes paved, sometimes bare earth. That is enough space for a compact set of equipment sized for children under six. We suggest pieces with low decks and short slides, and seats that hold small children securely. Send us the yard's measurements and a few photos, and we will mark the safe play area for each piece on a layout drawing.

sections.h: Fitting a playground into a play school yard
sections.html:
A compact station such as Tiny Tot, with a tube slide, an open slide and steps, uses one safe play area for several activities. Add two spring riders such as the Duck Spring Rider and you have a full set for a small yard.

On a paved yard, a self-standing base may be possible. On bare earth, posts are grouted. Either way, lay rubber flooring under the equipment, as small children fall often. North Bihar summers are hot, so keep the play area in shade after mid-morning. See our Bihar page, or our outdoor gym equipment in Chapra.

faq.q: Can a small play school yard fit playground equipment?
faq.a: Usually, yes. A compact multi play station and a couple of spring riders fit most small yards. Send us the measurements and photos and we will show the fit on a layout drawing.

faq.q: Is rubber flooring needed for very young children?
faq.a: We strongly suggest it. Young children fall often, and rubber flooring cushions those falls far better than tiles, concrete or hard earth.

faq.q: Do you supply playground equipment to Saran district?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Chapra by road and install it with our team or a Bihar dealer.

intro: Chinsurah, on the west bank of the Hooghly, was once a Dutch trading settlement and is now the headquarters of Hooghly district. Some of its schools and colleges sit on old campuses with large trees and heritage buildings. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,650 km away, and supplies schools, residential complexes, clubs and municipal parks in Chinsurah and nearby towns.

Old campuses bring their own planning questions. Big trees give welcome shade in the humid Bengal summer, but their roots and falling branches need thought. Heritage buildings mean a school may not want bright, loud colours right beside an old facade. We plan the play area around existing trees, and with 15+ roto-moulded shades available, we can suggest softer colour combinations that sit comfortably next to older buildings.

sections.h: Planning play equipment around old trees
sections.html:
Keep footings outside the main root zone of large trees, which usually spreads well beyond the trunk. Check overhead for dead branches before you fix the layout, and keep swings out from under heavy limbs.

Leaves and fruit drop through the year here, so plan a weekly sweep of the rubber flooring and the slide beds. The shade means less heat on the equipment, but more damp, so scrub slides in the monsoon. Garden pieces like the Curve Bench fit quietly into an older campus. See our West Bengal page, or our outdoor gym equipment in Chinsurah.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be installed under large trees?
faq.a: Yes, with care. Keep footings clear of the main roots, check for dead branches overhead and keep swings away from heavy limbs. We plan positions from your site photos.

faq.q: Can you suggest colours that suit a heritage campus?
faq.a: Yes. With 15+ roto-moulded shades, we can suggest softer combinations such as greens and beiges that sit well beside older buildings. Share photos of the campus.

faq.q: Do you install playground equipment in Hooghly district?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from Vasai by road and install it in Chinsurah and nearby towns with our team or a West Bengal dealer.

intro: Chittoor lies in the south of Andhra Pradesh, close to the Tamil Nadu and Karnataka borders and not far from Tirupati. The district is known for its mango orchards, and many of its schools sit on wide, open plots on the edge of town. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to Chittoor's schools, colleges, residential layouts and parks from our factory in Vasai, about 950 km away.

A large school ground gives you choices that a city plot does not. Instead of packing everything into one corner, you can spread equipment into separate areas for different classes, so juniors and seniors play at the same time without crowding. The trade-off is supervision, since teachers need to see each area. We plan layouts that keep the play zones within sight of each other and of the school building.

sections.h: Spreading equipment across a large school ground
sections.html:
Set up two or three zones: one for the pre-primary section with low pieces, one for primary classes with swings, see-saws and slides, and one for older students with climbers. A Kagzi origami-inspired structure such as Paper Boat makes a good centrepiece for the primary zone.

Chittoor is hot for most of the year, with rain mainly from the later monsoon months. Plant shade trees between zones, and lay rubber flooring under each group of equipment. See our Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh page, or our outdoor gym equipment in Chittoor.

faq.q: Should a large school ground have one play area or several?
faq.a: Several zones usually work better, split by age, so different classes can play at once. Keep them within sight of each other so teachers can supervise easily.

faq.q: What age group is Paper Boat designed for?
faq.a: Our catalogue lists Paper Boat for children aged 5 to 12. It is part of the Kagzi collection in our Funplay Originals range, designed by our own team.

faq.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Chittoor?
faq.a: Yes. We make the equipment in Vasai, about 950 km away, and send it by road. Our team or a dealer in Andhra Pradesh installs it.

intro: Cuttack is one of Odisha's oldest cities, built on a strip of land between the Mahanadi and the Kathajodi rivers. Its neighbourhoods are dense, its parks are well used, and many of them have stood for decades. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for Cuttack's schools, parks, residential complexes and clubs. We build it at our Vasai factory, about 1,360 km away, and install it with our team or a dealer in Odisha.

In older parks, the surface under the equipment is often the weakest part. Hard-packed soil, broken tiles or bare concrete are common, and none of them cushion a fall. Cuttack's heavy monsoon makes soil patches muddy and slippery for weeks. Adding rubber flooring under existing or new equipment is one of the most useful upgrades a park committee or school can make. We supply rubber flooring along with our play equipment.

sections.h: Adding rubber flooring to an older play area
sections.html:
Rubber flooring needs a firm, level base. On a site with broken tiles or uneven soil, the base is prepared first, with a slight slope so rainwater runs off rather than pooling.

Cover the full safe play area of each piece, including the landing zone at the foot of every slide and the space in front of and behind swings. If you are replacing old equipment at the same time, plan the new layout first so the flooring matches it. A new Zig Zag Slide on fresh flooring can revive an old corner. See our Odisha page, or our outdoor gym equipment in Cuttack.

faq.q: Can rubber flooring be laid in an existing park?
faq.a: Yes, on a firm, level base. Broken tiles or uneven soil are prepared first, with a slope for drainage. We supply rubber flooring along with our playground equipment.

faq.q: How much area should rubber flooring cover?
faq.a: The full safe play area of each piece, including slide landing zones and the space in front of and behind swings. We mark these areas on the layout drawing.

faq.q: Do you supply playground equipment in Cuttack?
faq.a: Yes. We make everything at our Vasai factory and send it to Cuttack by road. Our team or a dealer in Odisha installs it.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: Fact list says FunPlay supplies rubber flooring; it does not say FunPlay lays it or prepares the base. Copy avoids saying who does the base work.

intro: Danapur is a cantonment town on the western side of Patna, along the Ganga, and the stretch between it and the state capital is filling with apartment buildings. Builders and new housing societies here are adding play areas for families with young children. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 1,430 km away, and supplies Danapur's societies, schools and colonies by road.

A society play area gets judged twice. First when flats are sold, from photographs, and then every evening by the families who live there. It has to look good and work well for years. We plan a layout that fits the society garden, keeps play away from parking and driveways, and marks the safe play area around every piece. The building's maintenance staff get our care instructions at handover.

sections.h: Society play areas between Danapur and Patna
sections.html:
Most new societies here have a garden or a podium between towers. A medium multi play station such as Coral Cascade gives children a single landmark to gather around, and a pair of swings or spring riders fills out the space.

The Ganga plain has hot summers and a heavy monsoon, so plan drainage before the flooring goes down. Galvanised posts and roto-moulded parts carry a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. For the wider city, see our Patna page, or our outdoor gym equipment in Danapur.

faq.q: What should a new society include in its play area?
faq.a: Usually one multi play station as the main feature, plus swings or spring riders. We fit these to your garden or podium and mark each safe play area on the layout drawing.

faq.q: Who maintains the playground after installation?
faq.a: The society's maintenance staff, using the care steps we share at handover. For spare parts or repairs, contact our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921.

faq.q: Do you install playground equipment in Danapur?
faq.a: Yes. Equipment is sent from Vasai by road and installed by our team or a dealer serving Bihar, grouted or self-standing.

intro: Darbhanga is the cultural centre of Mithila in north Bihar, a region known for Madhubani painting and for the rivers that flood its plains most monsoons. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to Darbhanga's schools, colleges, hospitals and residential colonies from our factory in Vasai, about 1,530 km away. We send the equipment by road and install it with our team or a dealer.

Schools in Mithila sometimes ask whether a playground can carry a local look. Our standard pieces come in 15+ roto-moulded colours, and design customisation is available on request. A school can choose a palette inspired by the bold reds, yellows and greens of local art, or ask us about custom panels. Share what you have in mind with your enquiry, and we will tell you what is possible for your order.

sections.html:
Much of the land around Darbhanga sits low and stays waterlogged after heavy rain. Before installation, raise the play area with compacted fill above the usual water level, and slope it to a drain.

Grout the posts into concrete footings, which hold steady when the soil softens. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic come through floodwater without rusting, but clear silt from the equipment and flooring once the water drops. Install in the dry months, after the rains. A Wall Play panel can also be fixed along a school boundary wall. See our Bihar page, or our outdoor gym equipment in Darbhanga.

faq.q: Can playground colours reflect local art?
faq.a: We have 15+ roto-moulded colours, so a school can choose a palette inspired by local art. Design customisation is available on request, and we will confirm what is possible for your order.

faq.q: What happens to playground equipment after a flood?
faq.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic do not rust in floodwater. Once the water drops, wash off silt, check fixings and clear the drains around the play area.

faq.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Darbhanga?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture in Vasai and send the equipment to Darbhanga by road. Our team or a Bihar dealer installs it.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: Wall Play panels 'fixed along a boundary wall' assumed from the series name; confirm mounting method.

intro: Davanagere in central Karnataka is a well-known education town, with medical, engineering and other colleges, and many schools run by the same education trusts. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to these campuses and to Davanagere's housing layouts and parks from our factory in Vasai, about 630 km away. Equipment is sent by road and installed by our team or a dealer in Karnataka.

An education trust with several institutions often wants one supplier for all its schools. That keeps maintenance, spare parts and warranty records simple across campuses. We can prepare a separate layout for each school, sized to its ground and age groups, and quote them together. The central Karnataka climate is warm and fairly dry, with a moderate monsoon, so galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit it well.

sections.h: Playgrounds for education trusts with several campuses
sections.html:
List each campus with its ground size, age groups and a few photos. We then suggest equipment per site. A primary school may need swings, see-saws and a small multi play station, while a campus with older students may want climbers or a larger structure from the NexLev Escapade range.

Using the same models across schools means the maintenance staff learn one routine, and spare parts can be ordered by product name. Our warranty records are kept per piece. See our Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh page, or our outdoor gym equipment in Davanagere for college campuses.

faq.q: Can you supply several schools under one trust?
faq.a: Yes. Share the details of each campus and we will prepare a separate layout for each, with one combined quote. Standard models across schools keep maintenance simple.

faq.q: What equipment suits a campus with older students?
faq.a: Climbers, net structures and larger play towers such as our NexLev range. Younger children need separate, lower pieces, which we place in their own zone.

faq.q: Do you install playground equipment in Davanagere?
faq.a: Yes. We make everything at our Vasai factory, about 630 km away, and send it by road. Our team or a Karnataka dealer installs it.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: 'Our warranty records are kept per piece' is not in the fact list; remove if not accurate.

intro: Dehradun, the capital of Uttarakhand, lies in the Doon valley between the Shivalik hills and the Himalayan foothills. It is known for its residential schools, and many of them have large, green campuses. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to Dehradun's schools, housing societies, hotels and parks. We make it at our factory in Vasai, about 1,320 km away, and send it by road.

A residential school's playground is used every day, morning and evening, by children who live on campus. It needs equipment with real challenge for older children, and enough variety to stay interesting through the year. Dehradun's monsoon is heavy, and winters are cold and damp. Larger play towers, climbing structures and wooden designs from our NexLev series suit campuses with space to spare. Day schools and housing societies in the city usually have less room, and for them a compact multi play system from CoreCraft is the more practical choice. We send a layout drawing either way, with the safe play area marked around every piece.

sections.html:
Many Dehradun campuses sit on sloping ground. Rather than levelling a whole hillside, we can place equipment on terraces, each with its own level base and drainage. Keep paths between terraces wide and well lit.

Our NexLev Pinnacle towers and NexLev Woody wooden structures give older children climbing, sliding and lookout points. Heavy rain from late June to September calls for a sloped, drained base with rubber flooring. Scrub moss from shaded surfaces during the rains. See our Uttarakhand and Himachal Pradesh page, or our outdoor gym equipment in Dehradun.

faq.q: Can playground equipment go on sloping ground?
faq.a: Yes, on terraces. Each terrace gets its own level base, drainage and rubber flooring. We plan the layout from site photos and rough levels of the slope.

faq.q: What equipment suits a residential school?
faq.a: Larger play towers and climbing structures for older children, with a separate set of lower pieces for juniors. Our NexLev range includes towers and wooden designs for big campuses.

faq.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Dehradun?
faq.a: Yes. Equipment is made at our Vasai factory and sent by road. Our team or a dealer serving Uttarakhand installs it, grouted or self-standing.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: Terraced installation is general planning advice; FunPlay has not confirmed it as a service.

intro: Dehri, also called Dehri-on-Sone, sits on the bank of the Sone river in Rohtas district, south-west Bihar. Its schools, railway colonies and residential areas are our likely buyers. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,320 km from Dehri, and sends it by road for installation by our team or a dealer serving Bihar.

If you are planning a playground for the first time, a clear enquiry saves a lot of back-and-forth. We need to know how big the space is, who will use it and what the ground is like. With that, we can suggest equipment and draw a layout in one round. Below is what to send. Dehri's summers are very hot and the monsoon is heavy, so tell us about shade and drainage too.

sections.h: What to send us for a quick, accurate quote
sections.html:
• The length and width of the space, even if rough. Note any trees, poles, walls or drains inside it.
  • The age group of the children and roughly how many will play at once.
  • Photos of the ground from each corner, and one taken in the afternoon to show shade.

Send these to sales@funplaysystems.com or call +91 902 830 2266, Monday to Saturday. We reply with suggested equipment and a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. Browse our individual equipment if you already have pieces in mind. See our Bihar page, or our outdoor gym equipment in Dehri.

faq.q: What information do you need to suggest playground equipment?
faq.a: The size of the space, the age group and number of children, and photos of the ground. Mention trees, walls, drains and shade, since these affect where each piece can go.

faq.q: Do we need exact measurements?
faq.a: Rough measurements are enough to start. We use them for the first layout drawing, and you can confirm exact dimensions before approving the layout and quote.

faq.q: Do you supply playground equipment to Dehri-on-Sone?
faq.a: Yes. We make the equipment in Vasai and send it to Dehri by road. Our team or a dealer serving Bihar installs it.
